vocab.meaning_vi: gặp nhau ở giữa, thoả hiệp

vocab.meaning_vi: đòn bẩy, lợi thế để mặc cả

vocab.example: Let me check with my manager and make a concession there.

vocab.example: If you add free training, we might agree on terms faster.

vocab.meaning_vi: ưu đãi thêm để hấp dẫn hơn
vocab.example: I can offer free training as a sweetener for this deal.

vocab.example: We don't need to haggle over price if the extras are strong enough.

listening.title: Đàm phán giá và điều khoản hợp đồng

lines.speaker: Minh (Sales)
lines.text: Thanks for meeting again. Let's talk about the final price today.

lines.speaker: Trang (Purchasing Manager)
lines.text: Sure. Honestly, your quote is above our floor price.

lines.speaker: Minh (Sales)
lines.text: I understand. What's your bottom line for this deal?

lines.speaker: Trang (Purchasing Manager)
lines.text: If you can add free training, we might agree on terms faster.

lines.speaker: Minh (Sales)
lines.text: That's fair. I can offer that as a sweetener for a one-year contract.

lines.speaker: Trang (Purchasing Manager)
lines.text: Good. Can you also use your leverage to get us a better shipping rate?

lines.speaker: Minh (Sales)
lines.text: Let me check with my manager and make a concession there if possible.

lines.speaker: Trang (Purchasing Manager)
lines.text: We don't need to haggle over price if the extras are strong enough.

lines.speaker: Minh (Sales)
lines.text: Great, let's try to meet in the middle on the support package too.

lines.speaker: Trang (Purchasing Manager)
lines.text: Deal. Send me the updated terms by tomorrow.

lines.speaker: Minh (Sales)
lines.text: I will. Thanks for negotiating in good faith today.

lines.speaker: Trang (Purchasing Manager)
lines.text: Likewise, this was a productive conversation.

questions.q: What is above the client's floor price?
What do they agree to send by tomorrow?
